Zephyr portal uploads for motor claims

This invented guidance is used only in ClaimDesk tests.

Uploading a payment pack

Log in to the Zephyr portal with the account issued to your business.

Upload the payment pack as a single PDF file no larger than 20 MB.

After uploading, email the handler the portal reference shown on the confirmation screen.
